motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Department of Transportation be instructed to erect permanent ceremonial signs bearing the designations "MADRID THEATRE - Canoga Park Arts Hub" at the Madrid Theatre, 21622 Sherman Way; “TAXCO THEATRE - Canoga Park Arts Hub" at the Taxco Theatre, 7242 Owensmouth Avenue; and "CANOGA PARK YOUTH ARTS CENTER - Canoga Park Arts Hub" at the Canoga Park Youth Arts Center, 7222 Remmet Avenue in recognition of their collective contributions to the cultural, artistic, educational, economic, and civic life of Canoga Park and the West Valley.
